name: Joseph Tang
bio: I am an undergraduate in Information Engineering at Southeast University. My research centers on electromagnetic metasurfaces, near-field wave control, and machine learning for physical systems. I am interested in connecting computational design with measurements to build more capable sensing and wave-control devices.
experience_bio: I was an exchange student and research assistant at the University of California, Berkeley in 2025, working on ultrasound sonochemistry in the Liwei Lin Lab. In July 2026, I joined the EUSC × AISE Research Track at CUHK-Shenzhen to study metasurface-assisted near-field localization. My other projects span spoof surface plasmon sensing, radar–vision gesture recognition, and AI-assisted near-field focusing.
